comments.body:
I don't think render is async, even though it “feels” like it is. 
https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/9f286b46ff4b43cdb7debf52784d56c6ae43540b/packages/mermaid/src/diagrams/flowchart/flowDb.js#L16-L33

All diagrams use db's with module level state, so you can't render in parallel. (Well, you _can_, but your diagrams will be rendered wrong). 

This is a drawback which should be fixed, but it'll be another MAJOR rewrite.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment identifies a performance concern and potential race condition, and explicitly suggests a concrete alternative implementation using Promise.all with a code example.
